register.labelZh: SHAKE 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: shake down 可以表示新團隊、小組或系統逐漸建立順暢有效的運作方式。；shake somebody off 可以表示擺脫跟蹤者;shake something off 則可以表示擺脫疾病或不快的感覺。；shake on something 表示以握手確認協議;shake something out 則表示把某物抖開或抖走當中的塵埃。；shake something up 表示重大改變;shake somebody up 表示情緒受到震動;shake down 的不同用法亦可能出現在罪案故事和警方報道中。
register.summaryEn: Shake down can describe a new team, group or system slowly settling into an effective routine. Shake somebody off describes escaping from a person following you. Shake something off can describe recovering from an illness or an unpleasant feeling. Shake on something confirms an agreement with a handshake. Shake something out describes opening or cleaning something by shaking it. Shake something up describes major change. Shake somebody up describes emotional shock. Different uses of shake down may appear in crime stories and police reports.

questions.answer: When the wind stopped, the campers shook the wet sheet out and left it in the sun.
questions.answerZh: 風停後,露營者把濕床單抖開,並把它留在陽光下晾曬。
questions.targetMeaningZh: 把某物抖開或抖動整理
